template: Animate my logo in a {STYLE} style. The logo is the wordmark "{LOGO}". {DIRECTION} Write it as one self-contained index.html: a 720x720 stage, CSS and JavaScript inline, animated with GSAP from ./gsap.min.js (no other libraries, no network). Build one GSAP timeline, 4 seconds long, paused, and expose it as window.__tl so it can be rendered frame by frame: no requestAnimationFrame loops, no CSS animations, and if you need randomness use a seeded random. Every frame should look designed, and the logo must be clearly readable from 2.5 s to the end. Save it as index.html.

styles.name: particles
styles.direction: Hundreds of small particles swirl in from the edges and settle into the letterforms, with a soft glow and a few stray sparks still drifting at the end.

styles.name: liquid morph
styles.direction: A glossy liquid blob stretches, splits and merges, then morphs into the letters with a gooey metaball look.

styles.name: holographic
styles.direction: Iridescent rainbow foil that shifts as a light sweep passes over it, on a dark background, with a faint scanline shimmer.

styles.name: neon glow
styles.direction: A neon sign on a dark brick-like wall: the tubes flicker on letter by letter, buzz once, then glow steady with a coloured halo.

styles.name: wireframe 3D
styles.direction: The letters are built as 3D wireframe outlines in perspective, rotating slowly into a front-facing view, with a vector-grid floor.

styles.name: glassmorphism
styles.direction: Frosted glass cards with blur, soft borders and coloured blobs drifting behind them; the logo sits on the front card.

styles.name: kinetic typography
styles.direction: Bold type that slams, stretches, stacks and repeats in rhythm before locking into the final wordmark.

styles.name: isometric
styles.direction: An isometric scene where the letters rise out of a platform as extruded blocks, with clean flat shading.

styles.name: clay 3D
styles.direction: Soft, rounded, matte clay letters with a playful squash-and-stretch bounce as they drop in, pastel colours, soft shadows.

styles.name: ASCII art
styles.direction: A terminal-style grid of monospace characters that scrambles, then resolves into the logo drawn in ASCII characters.

styles.name: gradient mesh
styles.direction: A slow, rich multicolour gradient mesh flowing in the background, with the logo cut out in clean white type.

styles.name: comic book
styles.direction: Halftone dots, a bold black outline, a burst shape and a POW-style impact frame as the logo punches in.

styles.name: split-flap
styles.direction: An airport split-flap board where each tile flips through characters until it lands on the logo, with a slight shadow on each flap.

styles.name: retro VHS
styles.direction: A VHS tape look: tracking lines, colour bleed, chromatic aberration and a PLAY timestamp, the logo glitching into place.

styles.name: halftone
styles.direction: A two-colour halftone print look where dot sizes animate to reveal the logo, like a printed poster.

styles.name: Bauhaus
styles.direction: Primary-colour circles, squares and triangles slide, rotate and snap into a balanced Bauhaus composition around the logo.

styles.name: pixel art
styles.direction: Chunky 8-bit pixels that build the logo block by block on a small grid, with a retro game-style sparkle.

styles.name: blueprint
styles.direction: A technical blueprint: white line drawing on blue paper, construction lines and dimension markers drawing the logo.

styles.name: art deco
styles.direction: Gold and black art deco linework: symmetric fans, sunbursts and stepped frames drawing in around an elegant wordmark.

styles.name: neo-brutalism
styles.direction: Flat, loud colours, thick black borders, hard offset shadows and blocky cards that jolt into place around the logo.
